content: Do you know intended preflight API/signatures? Need write RED tests now; please share planned exports.
I need your planned API to avoid conflicting tests. Please reply with module/export and method signatures immediately.
Please share API/signatures for preflight tests; status shows idle.

Canonical API for implementation alignment: add `src/preflight/preflight-runner.js` exporting `PreflightRunner`; constructor `new PreflightRunner(store, { requiredChecks, protectedPaths = [] })` with no setter; `run(changeId, { currentRevision, changedFiles, checkResults })` returns `{ allowed, results, state }`; `getStatus(changeId)` reads persisted result or null. Required checks/config are injected host-owned, never supplied per run. Runner reads proof, blocks missing/stale/protected-path/failing checks, persists controller results separately from proof.workerChecks, and transitions PREFLIGHT→REVIEW only on all required checks passing. Match RED tests from luna-tests; do not implement alternate setRequiredChecks/invalidateProof APIs unless tests prove strictly necessary.

Important: luna-tests reports the RED file content was revised in workspace to the earlier exact contract: `createPreflightPolicy` in `src/preflight/preflight.js`; `ChangeStore.open(file,{preflightPolicy})`; `store.runPreflight(changeId,{currentRevision,changedFiles,checkResults})`; `store.getPreflight`; checkResults `{name,passed,exitCode,output}`; requiredChecks override/protected path cases. Treat the current test file as canonical and inspect it before implementation. Do not rely on stale task output/API messages. Keep scope minimal and report any mismatch.
